title: Selector Submod for Lazy's Corrupted Reskins 1.0.0
author: AkaClear
description:
A submod for Lazy's Corrupted Reskins. Made for those who only use reskin packs.

All credits goes to Lazyicarus and Variant Selector's author. This is only a selector submod.

First you need Variant Selector from steam , and all the reskin files you want , all three characters supported.

Then enable all reskin pack , put this below those files and done, you can now choose from all installed reskins.
